task: Design a battery for power tools: nominal capacity >= 2 Ah, support 5C discharge (capacity retention >= 95%), support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating), maximum temperature <= 60C, power density >= 4000 W/kg.

objective_breakdown: Nominal capacity >= 2 Ah; 5C discharge retention >= 95%; 4C fast charge no plating; T_max <= 333.15 K; power density >= 4000 W/kg.
candidate_strategy: R1: Chen2020 baseline characterization (1C/5C/4C). Ceiling assessment for 5C retention. R2-4: Architecture optimization (thickness/porosity/particle size). R5-8: Material design if ceiling exceeded (electrolyte transport improvement).
budget_allocation: R1-2 baseline 20%, R3-5 arch 40%, R6-8 material 30%, R9+ fine-tuning 10%
risk_and_fallback: Risk1: 5C retention <95% with Chen2020 params -> material escalation. Risk2: 2Ah requires large area -> high DCR -> poor rate. Risk3: 4C plating -> increase N/P or t+. Risk4: T_max>60C -> increase cooling h.

note: Baseline fails 5C retention (8.74% vs 95% target) and 4C plating (anode min -0.44V). Capacity and power density pass. Ceiling assessment: electrode transport fundamentally limits 5C performance; architecture optimization or material escalation needed.｜未检查 criteria: five_c_retention

Corrected evaluation: capacity from 1C discharge (4.95 Ah), 5C retention 8.74% (FAIL), plating YES (FAIL), T_max 332.4K (PASS), power density 22383 W/kg (PASS). Baseline fundamentally inadequate for 5C rate.

candidates.name: Architecture A
candidates.role: 50pct thinner electrodes, higher porosity, smaller particles

candidates.name: Architecture B
candidates.role: 65pct thinner, very high porosity, smallest particles

candidates.name: Architecture C
candidates.role: Ultra-thin 80pct reduction, max porosity, minimal particles

candidates.name: Architecture D
candidates.role: Moderate thinning with thin CC for mass reduction

llm_reason: Baseline 5C retention is 8.74% due to thick electrodes (75/85 um) limiting ion transport. Strategy: thin electrodes to reduce diffusion path, increase porosity for electrolyte access, reduce particle size for shorter solid-phase diffusion. Four variants spanning moderate to aggressive thinning. Capacity expected to drop from 5.0 Ah but should remain above 2 Ah target with adequate electrode area.

R2 results: B(65pct) achieves 95.2% retention but only 1.65Ah; A(50pct) has 2.53Ah but only 85.3% retention. The sweet spot is between A and B. Three refined variants interpolating thickness (28-35um pos), porosity (0.42-0.44), and particle size (2.0-2.5um) to find the 2Ah + 95% retention intersection.

candidates.name: Architecture G + Enhanced Electrolyte
candidates.role: Arch G electrodes + high-sigma high-tplus electrolyte + aggressive cooling

llm_reason: Arch G passes 5C retention (96.3%) and capacity (2.31Ah) but 4C charge shows borderline plating (anode min -0.004V) and T_max 343K. Root cause: electrolyte transport limits salt diffusion at 4C. Solution: enhanced electrolyte (sigma=1.5 S/m, D=7.5e-10 m2/s, t+=0.45 vs baseline 0.2594) + aggressive cooling (h=50 vs default 10). The t+ increase from 0.26 to 0.45 should eliminate plating by reducing salt depletion at anode.

note: 5C retention 85.3% (FAIL), capacity 2.53Ah (PASS). Too thick for 95% retention.｜未检查 criteria: power_density_w_kg, five_c_retention, plated
5C retention 95.2% (PASS), capacity 1.65Ah (FAIL < 2.0). Too thin for capacity target.｜未检查 criteria: power_density_w_kg, five_c_retention, plated
5C retention 96.3% (PASS), capacity 2.31Ah (PASS). Architecture meets discharge criteria. 4C charge needs assessment.｜未检查 criteria: power_density_w_kg, five_c_retention, plated

All criteria PASS: capacity 2.31Ah, 5C retention 96.8%, no plating (anode min +0.005V), T_max 327.6K. Enhanced electrolyte (sigma=1.5, t+=0.45) + aggressive cooling (h=50) solved plating and thermal issues.

recommendation: Architecture G (54% thinner electrodes, high porosity, small particles) with enhanced electrolyte (sigma=1.5 S/m, t+=0.45) and aggressive cooling (h=50 W/m2K) meets all five criteria: capacity 2.31 Ah (>=2.0), 5C retention 96.8% (>=95%), no lithium plating at 4C (anode min +0.005V), T_max 327.6K (<=333.15K), power density 65280 W/kg (>=4000).

design_summary.electrolyte: Enhanced transport (sigma=1.5 S/m, D=7.5e-10 m2/s, t+=0.45)
